name: Aventura City Commission

meetings.pattern: Regular meeting the first Tuesday of each month at 6:00 p.m., except August and December (no meetings), at the Aventura Government Center Commission Chambers, 19200 West Country Club Drive, or virtually when the agenda says so. A workshop follows about two weeks later, usually a Thursday at 9:00 a.m. in the 5th floor Executive Conference Room. The Local Planning Agency meets at 6:00 p.m. before regular meetings when there are zoning items.

schedule.note: Commission Inauguration Ceremony, Commission Chamber (swearing in of November 3 winners)
November regular meeting, moved from the first Tuesday because of the election; Commission Chamber

phases.name: Budget review meeting
phases.decides: The Commission reviews the City Manager's proposed FY 2026/27 operating and capital budget at a 9:00 a.m. meeting and sets the tentative millage.

phases.name: September budget hearings
phases.decides: First Budget Public Hearing September 8 at 6:00 p.m. and Second Budget Public Hearing September 15 at 5:01 p.m. adopt the millage and the FY 2026/27 budget.

phases.name: Fiscal year begins
phases.decides: The 2026/2027 fiscal year budget takes effect; prior-year operating encumbrances lapse September 30.

phases.name: August recess
phases.decides: No Commission meetings in August (or December).

phases.name: Candidate qualifying for the November 2026 election
phases.decides: Who runs for Mayor and Commission Seats 2, 4 and 6; 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. with the City Clerk.

phases.name: General and special election
phases.decides: Mayor (Howard S. Weinberg v. Alberto Zaltzberg); Seats 2, 4 and 6 unopposed (Orlinsky, Kruss, Bloom); two charter questions on elected officials' salaries and auditor rotation.

phases.name: Commission inauguration
phases.decides: Winners of the November 3 election are sworn in at 7:00 p.m. in the Commission Chamber.

levers.how: Speak at the Public Comments item near the end of each regular meeting (after Staff Reports) or at a public hearing item. To speak on a consent agenda item, tell the City Clerk before the meeting starts; you are recognized before the consent agenda is approved.
levers.rules: No time limit, sign-up form or speaker rule is printed on the agenda or the meetings page. The Commission Chambers are open to the public; meetings may be virtual when the agenda says so.
levers.deadline: Consent agenda items: notify the Clerk before the meeting begins

levers.how: No written comment procedure is posted. Email the City Clerk's office.
Call or visit the Government Center, weekdays 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., or use the staff directory for individual commissioners.
Submit a public records request through the city's JustFOIA portal.
Florida's uniform municipal recall statute, F.S. 100.361, applies to the Mayor and Commissioners; the city charter text could not be checked for a city-specific provision.
levers.rules: Under F.S. 100.361, in a city with 25,000 or more registered electors the petition needs 1,000 electors or 5 percent, whichever is greater, gathered within 30 days and filed with the clerk within 30 days of the first signature.

levers.how: Qualify with the City Clerk during the August qualifying week: $100 charter qualifying fee, 1 percent state assessment, and a $500 refundable sign deposit. Candidates must have lived in the city continuously for one year before qualifying; Seat 2 candidates must live north of the Lehman Causeway and Seat 4 south of it.
levers.rules: 2026 window: August 10 to 14, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Seats 2, 4, 6 and Mayor were up in 2026; Seats 1, 3 and 5 are next in 2028. Resign-to-run notice is due at least 10 days before qualifying opens.
levers.deadline: 4:30 p.m. on the last day of the August qualifying week

levers.how: City elections are held with the November general election in even years; vote through Miami-Dade Elections by mail, early voting or at your precinct.
levers.rules: Registered Aventura voters; all seats are voted citywide (residential-area seats restrict only who may run).

levers.how: Apply for an advisory board through the Advisory Boards page or the Form Center.

elections.terms: Mayor and six commissioners (Seats 1 to 6) serve four-year terms, staggered: Mayor and Seats 2, 4, 6 in 2026; Seats 1, 3, 5 in 2028. The charter requires two commissioners to live north of the Lehman Causeway, two south, and two plus the Mayor anywhere in the city. Term limits and run-off rules were not found on the city pages.

contacts.name: Ellisa L. Horvath, MMC, City Clerk
